svg.aria-label: Kernel slack against the clock for the 44 U50 builds this figure reads from the ledger, and the slack of the images built at 130 and 135 MHz in build order. One tile closes 175 MHz; four tiles close 135.
svg.title: Kernel slack against the clock for the 44 U50 builds this figure reads from the ledger, and the slack of the images built at 130 and 135 MHz in build order. One tile closes 175 MHz; four tiles close 135.
svg.text: How far the clock was pushed, and what it left in slack
The slack of the kernel's worst path for the U50 builds this figure reads from docs/VALIDATION.md: for each, a
pattern that names the build's entry and captures the figure the ledger states there. A build closes timing when its
slack is not negative. Left: slack against the clock it was built at. Right: the drawn images built at 130 and 135
MHz, in the order they were built. The ledger's other slacks (repeats, probes, other designs, builds named only in
running text) are listed in the sidecar, not drawn.
slack (ns) against the clock built for (MHz)
slack of the 130 and 135 MHz images drawn, in build order
Missed, of the 44 builds drawn: one tile at 260 MHz, -3.163 (31 Aug); one tile at 150 MHz, -0.070 (1 Sep); four tiles at 145 MHz, -0.302 (1
Sep); four tiles at 135 MHz, -0.363 (16 Sep); one tile at 175 MHz, -0.102 (24 Sep). Every other one drawn closed. The sweep's closed points
(145, 150, 155, 160, 165, 170, 175 MHz) passed the conformance set on the card at 7 of 7; of the four-tile builds drawn, 10 closed 135 MHz,
with slack from +0.003 to +0.143 ns. Not drawn: the ledger's other slacks, listed in the sidecar - among them three misses at 135 MHz that
